name: letak-worker-tesco
description: Detects Tesco SK leaflets (hypermarket/supermarket) and returns new leaflet URLs.
author: Fancysoft / 0ics

execute.description: Parse the Tesco SK leaflet page and return leaflets that are not already known.

outputPath.description: Absolute path where the full result JSON should be written.

knownLeaflets.description: Leaflet keys already seen, each formatted as 'type|from|to' (e.g. 'HM|2026-07-01|2026-07-07'). Any leaflet whose key is not in this list is reported as new.

types.description: Optional case-insensitive leaflet-type filter (e.g. ['HM','SM']). When set, only leaflets of these types are returned; empty or absent means all types. Combined with knownLeaflets: a leaflet is returned only when it matches a type AND is new.

pageUrl.description: Override for the leaflet page URL (the fallback source). Defaults to https://www.tesco.sk/akciove-ponuky/letaky-a-katalogy. Given alone (no apiUrl) only the page is read.

apiUrl.description: Override for the leaflet GraphQL API, the primary source (a file:// URL is read as a saved response). Defaults to https://api.prod.retail.tesco.com/marketing/leaflets-be/graphql

customData.description: Optional source-specific hints passed through from the scanner/orchestrator.

outputPath.description: Path to the written result JSON.

count.description: Number of returned leaflets (new AND matching the type filter).

hasNew.description: True when at least one matching new leaflet was found.

leaflets.description: Matched leaflets (new AND of a requested type), each a downloadable PDF entry.

type.description: Leaflet type (e.g. 'HM' hypermarket, 'SM' supermarket). Part of the novelty key.

fileSize.description: Size of the result JSON in bytes.

terminate.description: Cancel a running scrape and clean up resources.
